label: Bible Study
prompt: Lo, children are an _____ of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verse: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
note: Solomon's psalm about building houses — and the best inheritance is children.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For I have satiated the _____ soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verse: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
note: God refills every weary, sorrowful soul — and Jeremiah wakes in the next verse saying his sleep was sweet.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the _____, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
verse: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
note: King Jehoiakim sliced up Jeremiah's scroll with a penknife and fed it to the fire — so Jeremiah dictated it again.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The _____ shall live by faith.
verse: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
note: Paul quotes Habakkuk 2:4 here — a line so central it gets quoted again in Galatians and Hebrews.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the _____: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verse: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
note: Isaac went out 'to meditate in the field at the eventide' — and looked up to see Rebekah's camels coming.
